lines.text: This is Language Explorer, a Star Learner game for reading and writing in English and Spanish. Big picture buttons lead the way, and every step is spoken out loud.
The Read tile opens sentences and books. Match pictures to red words, or open a cover twice to read a story one page at a time.
The Write tile practices letters. Choose a picture or hear the word first, then tap alphabet tiles or trace the grey outlines with a finger.
Alphabet tiles follow the word’s capital and small letters. After three tries or three hints, the right letter glows gold so she can finish the word.
The menu holds picture tutorials, English or Spanish, and letter-input choices. Nothing on the chrome asks her to read a button label.
Language Explorer. Words she can hear, tap, and write. Ready to play on the Star Learner console.
